description: Look up a .cook name on the CookOven name service: who owns it, when it was registered, its resolver/metadata pointers, and whether it is the owner's primary name. If the name is NOT registered, returns availability plus the live registration price (short 1–3 character names cost more than 4+ character ones). Use this before register_domain — it is free and touches no key. For the reverse direction (wallet → names) use get_owned_domains.

name.description: the .cook name, with or without the suffix (e.g. "bot" or "bot.cook")

name: resolve_domain
title: Resolve a .cook name
